Spear Combat Styles

Choose Spear for attacks that interrupt or burden a target, or for evasion and positional bonuses.

Spear - Vigor

Vigor pairs attacks with evasion and includes a sweep that gains damage when you are beside or behind a target.

Spear - Disabler

Disabler attacks can increase an enemy's ability costs or drain resources when interrupting an active ability. Fracture Strike benefits from control effects you applied, including Foggy Mind and Force Disruption.

Quick Answers

What does Spear focus on?
